parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: Figures are taken from the Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation table ($ in thousands). The summary slides show the same results rounded in millions: Q4 25 $58.0, Q4 24 $52.4, FY 25 $216.3 and FY 24 $229.7. The excerpt does not state the period-end dates. They are inferred from Kadant's 52/53-week fiscal calendar, which ends on the Saturday closest to December 31: fiscal 2025 ended 2026-01-03 and fiscal 2024 ended 2024-12-28. Segment adjusted EBITDA figures (Flow Control, Industrial Processing, Material Handling) are excluded.
